systemCheckAttempts.result: Delayed TextEdit paste contained unrelated unexpected user text, so expected path was not established. No private clipboard content was retained.

systemCheckAttempts.action: Acquire com.apple.TextEdit to identify the dedicated temporary checker window before an atomic copy/paste flow.
systemCheckAttempts.result: CUA getApp call was interrupted by user after approximately 261 seconds; no app state returned, no clipboard paste, save or close action executed. Native control released to root.

systemCheckAttempts.action: Agent clicked exact combined filename Copy path and immediately signalled Root to paste with its existing TextEdit binding.
systemCheckAttempts.result: UI reported 已复制路径, but immediate system paste still contained previous unrelated content, not the expected path. No unrelated private text retained.
systemCheckAttempts.conclusion: Exact P system clipboard value remains unverified; cannot distinguish browser permission, automation bridge, or prototype clipboard handling defect. Stop retries per root.

copyCodeReview.behavior: await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value); success message only in fulfilled branch. catch sets context value and explicit copy permission unavailable feedback; finally-like code closes menu.
copyCodeReview.finding: No unconditional success toast found; no production/prototype change made from this unresolved tool observation.
